note: Real digests for version 0.1.3, built from the plugin repository's main branch at commit 39d3f025f7d0df5828faf5b38f6731dc9d2cbe61 (make release-with-prebuilt-fpp10 VERSION=0.1.3), the first commit where the native-prebuilt-fpp10 build path exists. Those artifacts are a private candidate build, not a published release, so the default artifact host still serves nothing for this version; the digests are what a bench or a later publication of that same build must match. Regenerate this file from the manifest whenever a new release is cut; there is no tooling that does it automatically. The native-prebuilt-fpp10 kind now carries all three architectures. The arm64 object was built once, on an Apple Silicon Mac under Docker Desktop, and stays single-host: no second host has built and compared it. The amd64 and armv7 objects were reproduced across two hosts, Apple Silicon under Docker Desktop and x86_64 under Docker CE, byte-identical; that is a two-host result, not evidence every host would agree.
